nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh thank the gods, actual living people. Do you know how long I've been stuck down here with THESE?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't answer that. The skeletons keep saying 'forever' and I think they mean it literally.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Saint-in-training. Well. Was. My order is... probably also skeletons now.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Take me with you. Please. I will heal everyone. I will heal you so hard. Just GET ME OUT OF THIS CATACOMB.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh thank you. Thank you. You have no idea. THANK YOU.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm following you anyway. You can't stop me. I'm a healer, not a fighter, but I WILL scream.
